messages.subject: [Rd] Treat multiline expressions as a single block in R Console history #1666
messages.subject_clean: Treat multiline expressions as a single block in R Console history #1666
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

When pasting a multiline expression into the console, it is one block
in the history on Linux, but not on Windows. Is this intended?

messages.subject: [Rd] Feature request: allow denominator n in var() and sd()
messages.subject_clean: Feature request: allow denominator n in var() and sd()
messages.body_plain:
Dear R-devel,

The current var() applies Bessel?s correction. There is a precedent in
cov.wt(..., method = "ML").
I found a related discussion: https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/r-devel/2019-February/077300.html
The argument name could follow R Core?s preferences.
